title: A pluricomplex error-function kernel at the edge of polynomial Bergman kernels
summary: We consider polynomial Bergman kernels with respect to exponentially varying weights $e^{-n \mathscr Q(z)}$ depending on a potential $\mathscr Q:\mathbb C^d\to\mathbb R$. We use these kernels to construct determinantal point processes on $\mathbb C^d$. Under mild conditions on the potential, the points are known to accumulate on a compact set $S_{\mathscr Q}$ called the droplet. We show that the local behavior of the kernel in the vicinity of the edge $\partial S_{\mathscr Q}$ is described in two different ways by universal limiting kernels.
